how is LTV calculated

LTV (Loan to Value) is calculated by dividing the loan amount by the property value and multiplying by 100 to express it as a percentage. In your case, the loan amount is ₹35 L and you are putting ₹20 L down, which means the property value is ₹55 L (35+20). So the LTV is (35/55)*100 = 63.63%.
